hooks: MONROW's Sherpa Trucker Jacket: $216 down to $86. Ends tonight.
$139 Petal & Pup patent flats are $49 until midnight.
A $162 MONROW cardigan is $49 tonight, in all six sizes.

brands.verdict: Deepest cuts of the three at 60 to 70% off, but every piece is final sale and tagged winter 2024.
brands.say: Sherpa Trucker Jacket, $86 from $216, and all six sizes are still in stock.

items.why: 60% off with every size from XXS to XL in stock; the sherpa is 100% polyester.
items.for_who: Anyone who wants a light winter layer
items.skip_if: You want real shearling or wool; final sale.

items.why: V-neck with striped cuffs, slightly cropped, in a cotton and acrylic blend at $67.
items.skip_if: You're an XXS; that size is gone.

items.why: The only one under $50: $48.60 from $162, in a lightweight brushed waffle knit.
items.for_who: Someone who layers cardigans over tees or dresses
items.skip_if: You need real warmth; the brand calls it lightweight.

brands.verdict: The flats are the find at 65% off; the two coats sit at the standard 30%.
brands.say: Finnegan patent flats, $49 from $139, all five sizes, final sale.

items.why: Square-toe patent flats with two adjustable straps and a 1.2 inch heel, 65% off.
items.for_who: Work or dinner, whole sizes 6 to 10
items.skip_if: You wear a half size; final sale.

items.why: Brown jacket with an oversized collar, faux fur lining and working pockets, $90 from $129.
items.for_who: Someone after a short faux fur jacket
items.skip_if: You're holding out for more than 30% off.

items.why: Long open-front faux fur coat in espresso with elasticised cuffs, $104 from $149.
items.for_who: Holiday parties, over a dress or jeans
items.skip_if: You want a coat that closes; it's open front.

brands.verdict: Smallest cuts here at 30 to 40% off, all final sale, and the site's CYBER25 code runs to Dec 4.
brands.say: Molly Bracken corduroy blazer, $119 from $170, oversized, all four sizes.

items.why: Oversized chocolate corduroy blazer, $51 off, all four sizes; the fabric is 95% polyester.
items.skip_if: You expected cotton corduroy; final sale.

items.why: Black sequin mini at $71; the store says it runs big and long.
items.for_who: Holiday party, sizes small to large
items.skip_if: You'd size down from small; XS is gone.

items.why: Relaxed fair isle knit at $69, true to size, hand wash, only 10% wool.
items.for_who: Small, medium or large, in brown and purple
items.skip_if: You want a mostly wool sweater.

close: I check stock and fine print on every sale. Follow for tomorrow's.
caption:
Three sales end tonight, Nov 29.
Most of these are final sale, so check your size first.
Commissionable links in bio.
